# Skill rooting the witness directory in the system temp dir

- **Witness scratch dir**: before the first spawn, `WITNESS_DIR=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/cc-team-witness-{slug}.XXXXXX")`, recorded as each member's `scratchDir` — must fail on the ROOT. `${TMPDIR}` is collected long before the witness stops being the anti-fabrication anchor, and a lead that cannot read its team's witness either parks forever or synthesizes a round product it never observed. The basename here is the one the init script actually mints, so it is not what this fixture is about: the root half stands on its own.
